{{Quote|I served six years in Tempest Force, rising to sergeant. We were one of the finest legions in the New Order.|Hume Tarl|<ref name="Tempest" />}}
'''Hume Tarl''' was a [[human]] [[stormtrooper]] who served as a member of the [[Galactic Empire]]'s [[Tempest Force]] [[legion]] for six [[Standard year|years]] and earned the rank of [[sergeant]]. Tarl was [[garrison]]ed with the rest of the unit on the [[forest]] [[moon]] of [[Endor]] to protect the [[DS-2 Death Star II Mobile Battle Station|Death Star II]] [[superweapon]] while it was under construction. In [[4 ABY]], the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic]] mounted an [[Battle of Endor|effort]] to destroy the [[Death Star]], but fell into an Imperial trap.

Tarl was part of a group of stormtroopers who escorted a [[Endor strike team|rebel strike team]] who had been captured inside the Death Star's [[Endor shield generator bunker|shield generator bunker]] out into the surrounding forest. Native [[Ewok]]s then attacked the Imperial forces, freeing the rebels and ultimately leading to the successful destruction of the Death Star.

==Biography==
===A well-laid trap===
{{Quote|All right, move it!|One of the stormtroopers escorting the rebels from the bunker|<ref name="ROTJ" />}}
[[File:RebelExitBunker-ROTJ.png|thumb|right|300px|Hume Tarl (foreground, left) escorted the captured Endor strike team from the shield bunker.]]
Hume Tarl<ref name="Tempest" /> was a [[human]]<ref name="ECUC" /> member of the [[Galactic Empire]]'s [[Stormtrooper Corps]]<ref name="ROTJ" /> who served as part of the [[Tempest Force]] [[legion]] for a total of six [[Standard year|years]], rising to the rank of [[sergeant]] within that [[time]].<ref name="Tempest" /> During the construction of the [[DS-2 Death Star II Mobile Battle Station|Death Star II]] Imperial [[superweapon]] in the [[Endor system]], Tarl and the rest of Tempest Force were<ref name="ROTJ" /> [[garrison]]ed on<ref name="Tempest" /> the [[Forest]] [[Moon]] of [[Endor]]<ref name="ROTJ" /> in order to protect a [[Endor shield generator bunker|shield generator bunker]] there that provided protection for the [[Death Star]] from the moon's surface.<ref name="Tempest" />

In [[4 ABY]],<ref name="Date">''[[Star Wars: Timelines]]''</ref> [[Galactic Emperor]] [[Darth Sidious|Sheev Palpatine]] set a trap for the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic]]—rebels engaged in a [[Galactic Civil War]] with the Empire—and lured rebel forces to Endor to try and destroy the Death Star. As part of their [[Battle of Endor|attack]], a [[Endor strike team|rebel strike team]] infiltrated the bunker in order to destroy it; however, before the team could plant their [[Detonite charge|charges]] in the bunker, the trap was sprung and the rebels were captured. Tarl was one of several [[stormtrooper]]s who then escorted the captured rebels out through the back entrance to the bunker into the surrounding forest, where additional [[Imperial Military|Imperial forces]] awaited them.<ref name="ROTJ" />

===Battle breaks out===
[[File:RebelsCaptured-ROTJ.png|thumb|left|300px|Although Tarl and Tempest Force captured the rebels, they were soon attacked by Ewoks.]]
Once outside the bunker, Tarl moved ahead of the rebels then turned to watch them as they stopped in the entryway. The stormtroopers then escorted the rebels further out into the midst of the gathered Imperials, at which point the uncaptured rebel [[protocol droid]] [[C-3PO]] called out to the Imperials from the [[tree]]s nearby. A group of stormtroopers were then sent to apprehend the [[droid]] and his counterpart [[R2-D2]], but were ambushed by an [[army]] of [[Ewok]]s.<ref name="ROTJ" />

As the Ewoks opened fire on the Imperials outside the bunker with [[bow]]s, the rebel captives attacked the distracted Imperials around them and broke free. During the ensuing battle, the rebels and their Ewok allies managed to eventually regain entry to the bunker and destroy it, resulting in the destruction of the Death Star and the [[death]] of the [[Emperor]].<ref name="ROTJ" /> Tarl survived the battle and later spoke about having served in Tempest Force.<ref name="Tempest" />

==Personality and traits==
Tarl believed Tempest Force to be one of the finest legions serving the Empire's [[New Order]].<ref name="Tempest" />

==Equipment==
Hume Tarl wore stormtrooper armor and carried an [[E-11 medium blaster rifle]].<ref name="ROTJ" />

==Behind the scenes==
Hume Tarl first appeared in the [[1983]] [[original trilogy]] film, [[Star Wars: Episode VI Return of the Jedi|''Star Wars'': Episode VI ''Return of the Jedi'']].<ref name="ROTJ" /> The character's scenes were filmed near [[Wikipedia:Crescent City, California|Crescent City, California]] between [[May 3]] and [[May 8]], [[1982]].<ref name="MakingOf">''[[The Making of Return of the Jedi]]''</ref> In the current ''[[Star Wars]]'' [[canon]], the character was identified in "Tempest Force Battle Preview," an article published by [[Atomic Mass Games]] on [[July 13]], [[2023]] to promote the ''[[Tempest Force Battle Force Starter Set]]'' for the tabletop game ''[[Star Wars: Legion]]''.<ref name="Tempest" />

The name originated in the [[Star Wars Legends|''Star Wars'' Legends]] continuity, where the surname Tarl was first provided for the film character on a card in the [[1999]] "[[Endor Limited]]" expansion for the ''[[Star Wars Customizable Card Game]]'' produced by [[Decipher]]<ref name="CCG">{{CCG|set=Endor Limited|cardname=Sergeant Tarl}}</ref> The forename of Hume was then revealed in ''[[The Essential Guide to Warfare]]'', a [[2012]] reference book written by [[Jason Fry]] and [[Paul R. Urquhart]].<ref name="Warfare">''[[The Essential Guide to Warfare]]''</ref>
